svg.text: One altar
The beam rests on an equals sign; the pans weigh the same; the crystal's weight is the unknown
The crown is an equals sign
the beam rests on two gold bars
The beam stays level
the frozen crystal's chains hold it:
an unfair move rattles them and springs back
A frozen crystal
its weight is the number to find;
a Glimmer sleeps inside
Gems: one each
in rows of five, easy to count
Seven gems
the same weight as the left pan
The rune line
the altar's equation, carved; it changes
with every move and Hoot reads it aloud
Sharing bowls
split both pans into equal shares
The gem bag
put the same on both pans
Free the crystal: get it alone on its pan with fair moves. The other pan then shows what it weighs (here: four gems).
